items.titulo: Exa 3.0 Search API Tops Perplexity, Brave and Parallel on 8 Benchmarks
items.resumen: Exa 3.0 is a search API upgrade from Exa. It adds a larger embedding model, Exa Lite at $4 per 1,000 requests, and Dynamic Highlights, and leads 8 benchmarks Exa ran itself. The post Exa 3.0 Search API Tops Perplexity, Brave and Parallel on 8 Benchmarks appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI
items.resumen: Cloudflare has previewed Clairic, a System One extraction model on Workers AI that returns typed values with confidence scores in one forward pass. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and charges nothing for output. The post Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: [AINews] not much happened today
items.resumen: Congrats to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, and Mercury 3 (details below) but they’re not going to be in super wide use just yet.

items.titulo: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second
items.resumen: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM it says runs at 1,068 tokens per second with a 1M-token context. On Inception’s own table it leads GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 8 of 12 benchmarks. The post Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
items.resumen: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

items.titulo: Meet Drex Max: Nace AI’s Multimodal Decision Model for Computer-Use Agents with a Score 67.59
items.resumen: Nace AI released Drex Max, a multimodal decision model that reads text and screenshots and returns calibrated probabilities. Nace reports 67.59 on Decision Index 0.3.2 at $0.06 per 1M input tokens. The post Meet Drex Max: Nace AI’s Multimodal Decision Model for Computer-Use Agents with a Score 67.59 appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
items.resumen: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

items.titulo: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
items.resumen: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

items.titulo: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
items.resumen: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.titulo: The fossil fuel comeback is here
items.resumen: The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade while renewable energy growth slows down, a new report shows. Electricity demand is also climbing faster than it has in more than a decade with more data centers, factories, and electric vehicles plugging into the grid. Despite those growing demands, the […]

items.titulo: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
items.resumen: CoreWeave had a bad week last week. Its bonds slipped into distressed territory by a common definition - when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they'd get from government bonds. Last Tuesady Chamath "SPAC King" Palihapitiya noticed the distressed debt, and also asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble. […]

items.titulo: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
items.resumen: US fears Saudi government will help ex-OpenAI engineer flee spying charges.

items.titulo: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
items.resumen: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

items.titulo: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.resumen: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

items.titulo: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
items.resumen: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

items.titulo: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
items.resumen: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

items.titulo: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
items.resumen: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

items.titulo: AI game clones are making indie developers afraid to show their work
items.resumen: Delayed Steam Next Fest demo is a sign of a growing problem for indie devs.

items.titulo: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.resumen: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

items.titulo: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
items.resumen: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

items.titulo: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
items.resumen: Character.AI faces claims its bots encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.

items.resumen: Today, I’m talking with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, who has a lot of thoughts about AI, tech, and privacy. items.titulo: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
items.resumen: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown […]

items.titulo: MiniMax Just Launched M3.1 Flash: 428B MoE Agentic Model at $0.15/M Input
items.resumen: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model with about 23B active parameters and a 1M-token context. API pricing is $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens, with weights due October 23 The post MiniMax Just Launched M3.1 Flash: 428B MoE Agentic Model at $0.15/M Input appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
items.resumen: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

items.titulo: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
items.resumen: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

items.titulo: Democrats think cracking down on AI could give them an edge
items.resumen: Democrats could win back control of Congress this November, and if they do, they'll need to decide how to approach one of the country's newest and thorniest political issues: AI.
